First find the inverses modulo \(31\):

\[
3^{-1} \pmod{31}=21 \quad \text{since } 3\cdot 21=63\equiv 1 \pmod{31}
\]

\[
5^{-1} \pmod{31}=25 \quad \text{since } 5\cdot 25=125\equiv 1 \pmod{31}
\]

So,

\[
3^{-1}+5^{-1}\equiv 21+25=46\equiv 15 \pmod{31}
\]

Now we need the inverse of \(15\) modulo \(31\):

\[
15\cdot 29=435=31\cdot 14+1
\]

Thus,

\[
15^{-1}\equiv 29 \pmod{31}
\]

The answer is 29.
